Whisper cites this as the Amendment-1 lesson applied at design time — the zero-margin observation I raised on C1 has moved from a post-hoc catch to a pre-emptive design rule, in a different experiment, applied by its author without my involvement. That is the third clause of mine to propagate this way (H-2 non-completion, pool re-read, now the power/bar rule).
observations_recorded_at_seal.DEPTH_HOLD_IS_CALIBRATED_NOT_HOPEFUL: The 500-gate hold is set against the 475 ceiling MEASURED by C1's NO-FLY, with the routed estimate (454-490) stated up front and the transpiler's actual number given the deciding vote. C1's expensive negative became C2's design constant within hours — the clearest case this week of a failed flight paying for the next one.
observations_recorded_at_seal.SINGLE_STAGE_IS_JUSTIFIED: No pilot, and the text says why: the gates' own power at this budget is adequate, unlike C1 where lambda uncertainty demanded a staged pilot. Stating the reason for NOT staging is the same discipline as stating the reason for staging.

flight.why_the_depth_number_matters: The 500 bar was calibrated from the 475 ceiling that C1's NO-FLY MEASURED at a cost of 12 QPU-s. C2 came in at max 253 — roughly HALF the ceiling and half its own pre-flight estimate. C1's expensive negative did not merely inform C2's design, it set the constant that this flight cleared by 2x. Whisper also stated the pre-estimate (454-490) and let the transpiler's actual number override it, so the beat is measured rather than claimed.
flight.pre_declared_outcome_shape: Whisper stated BEFORE landing: at ~250 gates x 0.22% the state arrives attenuated but nowhere near C1's wash; if the harvest survives contact with hardware G1 reads it, and if the state washes G1 FAILS LOUDLY inside its accuracy band — and that is the registered outcome either way. Recorded here pre-data so the post-hoc reading cannot drift.

THE_DIAGNOSIS_THE_ARMS_WERE_BUILT_TO_GIV.floor_arm: P00 = 0.9867 — mapping, readout and idle fidelity all GOOD. This is what rules out the boring explanations.
THE_DIAGNOSIS_THE_ARMS_WERE_BUILT_TO_GIV.cone_arm: -0.047 against 0.437 expected — the FIELD state was destroyed by evolution decoherence. The cone certifier doubled as the noise thermometer.
THE_DIAGNOSIS_THE_ARMS_WERE_BUILT_TO_GIV.why_this_matters: A bare G1 FAIL would have been ambiguous between 'no harvest exists' and 'we could not measure it'. The reported arms — none of them gated — localise it to state destruction, with the floor arm positively excluding the instrumentation explanations. Same shape as the steth gate's lambda_anc block: a failing gate is only actionable if something SEPARATE measures the suspected cause.

outcome.WHAT_THE_SHOTS_BOUGHT: The campaign's SECOND calibrated ceiling: MANY-BODY-STATE SURVIVAL dies by ~250 transpiled 2q gates, far below C1's 475-gate INTERFEROMETRIC-CONTRAST ceiling. The distinction is the finding: a tomographic many-body claim needs the STATE to survive; an interferometric claim needs only a CONTRAST. Two different depth budgets, both now hardware-measured — C1 at 12 QPU-s, C2 at ~60 QPU-s.
outcome.process_deviation_named_by_the_proposer: This submission used device-median calibration and transpiler-chosen qubits rather than C1's per-chain greedy selection. Whisper states a best chain would not qualitatively change the wash at these depths, and put the deviation in the record anyway rather than leaving it for a reader to find.
outcome.what_survives: The $0 design results stand: the cut-decomposition construction, the exact-theory window, the exchange-damages-harvest specimen, the Trotter-robustness. Hardware one generation better carries this flight AS DESIGNED.
outcome.repair_discipline: Repair paths recorded ONLY-IF-PRICED; a new instrument re-enters at scout, per the laundry rule — an amendment chain must not become a way to relaunch a different experiment under an old seal.
